incident-bot: :pager: Pager triggered: metering.alerts.live_shadow_delta - Live meter < shadow by ~14% for eu-west-2 starting 2026-05-03T07:10Z. Possible false overage emails.
harper-oncall: taking it. Paging @mike-billing and @slo-sre. Any scheduled work?
mike-billing: no scheduled deploys. I see 10 overage_flags emitted in the last 35m. Samples: req-9f2, req-1b7. Shadow ledger stable.
slo-sre: checking ingestion and consumers. Quick kafka offsets check: partition 2 shows lag ~28000.
ops-bot: k8s: emitter-ingest-2 pod on node eu-node-7 showing OOMKilled events x3 in last 45m.
harper-oncall: pause billing emails for eu-west-2 region now. @zoe-cs please hold comms until we confirm.
zoe-cs: pausing templates. Notifying top-affected customers with "we are investigating; no charges applied yet" message.
slo-sre: restarting emitter-ingest-2 pod. Will also pull last 100 lines of pod log.
slo-sre: logs show repeated "kafka offset commit timeout" and GC pauses >5s before OOM.
ops-bot: restart action started: pod/emitter-ingest-2 restarted.
slo-sre: consumer lag dropping to 2.5k and counting down. Kicking off replay for window 2026-05-03T06:30Z-07:15Z: `meter-replay --shard 2 --from 06:30 --to 07:15` job=replay-1812123456-a
mike-billing: will run reconciler after replay and hold any invoices. Setting auto-clear threshold: delta <0.7% -> clear flags.
ops-bot: replay job progress: queued -> running -> 35%
zoe-cs: CS prepared messages; legal approved. Reaching out to top 4 customers now.
ops-bot: replay job completed -> triggering billing-reconcile job rec-1812123456-a
mike-billing: recon finished: 10 flags cleared, no invoices issued. CS confirmed customers notified and satisfied.
harper-oncall: root cause: emitter consumer OOM/GC -> delayed commits -> live tally lag -> overage flags. Remediations applied: restarted pod, paused emails, replay + reconcile.
slo-sre: follow-ups: SRE-3301 (heap tuning + add OOM heapdump), SRE-3302 (add readiness/liveness probe), BILL-5002 (safeguard to suppress short-lived deltas).
harper-oncall: leaving bridge open 20m to monitor. Great job. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Pager resolved: metering.alerts.live_shadow_delta severity=P2 duration=61m
